entities.summary: Roy Yves Nico Reding is a Luxembourgish lawyer, politician, and former vice-president of the ADR, as well as former treasurer of the Alliance of European Conservatives and Reformists (AECR), a centre-right eurosceptic European political party, of which the ADR is a member. Roy Reding was a legal figures from Luxembourg (b. 1965-07-17, Luxembourg). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
